iso_clamp.supply: receiver domain (core VDD for macro inputs)

iso_clamp_x4.function: Y = A AND NOT ISO, 4x output (clock nets, ~1 mm route)

iso_pd.function: analog/RF: nfet_03v3 0.5/0.28 pull-down Y->VSS while ISO=1; no series element
iso_pd.load_on_Y_fF: 1.75 extracted (1.40 to VSS + 0.35 to ISO) + 0.22 um2 junction

iso_control: ISO = ISLAND_OFF_<driving island> = NOT island_on[k] (glue inverter, VDD domain; honours the RTL pgood_override). Fallback if assembly prefers no glue: the isw_<island> ISO output (= NAND(EN,PG), VDD domain). island index: 0 wired, 1 rf, 2 pll, 4 conv, 5 debug.

placements.where: LO hub at the lo_ext outputs, next to the DBG-02 clk_obs tap; all four LO cells identical orientation and equal stub (<= 5 um), RA-19/RA-20 symmetry
within 30 um of the macro pin (core VDD)

placements.A: pll_cdr.FBCK (cdr.FBCK_IN stays on the A side)

placements.ISO: ISLAND_OFF_pll or ISLAND_OFF_wired (per the surviving driver)
placements.blocker: v3 binds TWO outputs to ct_word_clk (pt_wordclk.WORD_CLK and pt_wiredtx.WORD_CLK, both inverter outputs): contention. Assembly/digital must pick one (or mux) before the clamp is bound.

placements.where: at the wiredtx pin; removes the p-diff injection path into an off wired island (with the RA-3 digital interlock as a second layer)

not_clamped_with_reason.island_pgood[0..5]: driven by the isw PG inverters, which are VDD-powered (island_support design.py MPG2P/N): not island-driven (A6 false positive)
not_clamped_with_reason.cdr_freq_locked, ct_ser_run, rx_en_*, hs: macro outputs into island gates (core -> island, gate-only): no injection, the receiving island is either powered or its gates are unpowered
not_clamped_with_reason.island_on[0]: BLOCKER: v3 binds pt_wtx_fallback_control.WIRED_ON (an output) to island_on[0], which is also a macro output -> two drivers. Fix the binding first (WIRED_ON should go to a macro input or to the bring-up mux); if the fallback signal must reach core_bias.ON_wired, put an iso_clamp (ISO=ISLAND_OFF_wired) on that branch.
not_clamped_with_reason.LO_*/REF_IN/AUX_CLK pads into lo_ext: pad-driven (board): LU-03 power-before-drive rule; on-chip the rf_pair/refpad protection limits injection
not_clamped_with_reason.ATBN_* T-switch p-diff: RA-3 digital interlock (reject ATB codes of a non-pgood island)
